numbers.value: lean man (e 1400 kcal/day, q0 0.17, F0 9 kg, P0 10 kg, Pc 5 kg; AI-chosen round values): phase III below 1.1 kg fat, survival 76 days

note: Synthesis check after the fasting literature map: layer-3 persistence (maximise time above the protein threshold) is the survival objective of Clark-Mangel state-dependent models; with Hall's lipolysis ceiling (Eq. 11) it gives the mainstream fuel order and a phase-III fat threshold without a new term. Finding: in this objective the order of fuel use matters only through fat left unburned at death (energy conservation); sparing protein early pays off in survival time only if protein loss costs function before death, which this model omits and Noren and Mangel (2004) include. Not UET-distinct.
